'''LeBron Raymone''' "'''Bronny'''" '''James Jr.''' (born October 6, 2004) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[USC Trojans men's basketball|USC Trojans]]. A consensus four-star [[college recruiting|recruit]], James was named a [[McDonald's All-American]] as a [[senior (education)|senior]] in [[high school]] in 2023. He is the eldest child of professional basketball player [[LeBron James]].

==Early life and career==
[[File:LeBron James Jr.jpg|thumb|left|upright|James at the 2012 [[Miami Heat]] championship parade]]
James was born on October 6, 2004, in [[Akron, Ohio]], to reigning [[NBA Rookie of the Year Award|NBA Rookie of the Year]] LeBron James, age 19, and his girlfriend Savannah Brinson, age 18.<ref name="chron1">{{Cite web |last=Berkowitz |first=Lana |date=December 31, 2004 |title=In 2004, celebrities start their own baby boom |url=https://www.chron.com/life/article/In-2004-celebrities-start-their-own-baby-boom-1976596.php |access-date=July 31, 2018 |website=[[Houston Chronicle]]}}</ref> He was raised by both of his parents,<ref name="espn1">{{Cite web |date=December 10, 2005 |title=LeBron James: beyond his years, beyond the hype |url=https://www.espn.com/espn/wire/_/section/nba/id/2254792 |access-date=July 31, 2018 |website=[[ESPN.com]] |agency=Associated Press}}</ref> who married in 2013.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Lynn |first=SJ |date=October 23, 2019 |title=Who is LeBron James' wife? A timeline of the relationship between NBA star & Savannah Brinson |work=Sporting News |url=https://www.sportingnews.com/us/nba/news/lebron-james-wife-savannah-brinson-relationship-timeline/l0sgbsh3oj451evnmryqlf9ib |access-date=March 20, 2021}}</ref> As a child, James played several sports including basketball and [[soccer]], but his father did not allow him to play [[American football|football]] or [[ice hockey]] because of safety concerns.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Broussard |first=Chris |date=November 13, 2014 |title=LeBron: No football in my house |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/11866239 |access-date=July 31, 2018 |publisher=[[ESPN]]}}</ref><ref name="time1">{{Cite magazine |last=Dockterman |first=Eliana |date=November 13, 2014 |title=LeBron James Explains Why He Won't Let His Kids Play Football |url=http://time.com/3584387/lebron-james-youth-sports-football/ |access-date=July 31, 2018 |magazine=[[Time (magazine)|Time]]}}</ref> By the time he was 10 years old, his highlights from youth basketball games were drawing national attention.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Good |first=Dan |date=December 23, 2014 |title=LeBron James Jr. Is Pretty Good at Basketball, Too |url=https://abcnews.go.com/Sports/lebron-james-jr-4th-grade-basketball-star/story?id=27783254 |access-date=July 31, 2018 |website=[[ABC News]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Elliot |first=Danielle ==High school career==
===Freshman season===
[[File:Bronny James @ Memorial Day weekend L.A. Classic 2019 (cropped).jpg|thumb|upright|James with Strive for Greatness at the [[Nike EYBL]] in 2019]]
On May 29, 2019, James transferred to [[Sierra Canyon School]], a [[private school|private]] [[K–12]] school in [[Chatsworth, Los Angeles]], for his [[freshman]] year of high school. He joined the school with his brother [[Bryce Maximus James#Personal life|Bryce]] and incoming senior [[Zaire Wade]], son of [[Dwyane Wade]], a longtime teammate of James’ father.<ref name="pell">{{Cite news |last=Pell |first=Samantha |date=May 30, 2019 |title=Sons of NBA superstars LeBron James, Dwyane Wade to play together in high school |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/2019/05/30/sons-nba-superstars-lebron-james-dwyane-wade-play-together-high-school/ |access-date=June 2, 2019 |newspaper=[[The Washington Post]]}}</ref><ref name="scs">{{Cite web |last=Fattal |first=Tarek |date=May 29, 2019 |title=Bronny James, Zaire Wade expected to attend Sierra Canyon |website=[[Los Angeles Daily News]] |url=https://www.dailynews.com/2019/05/29/bronny-james-zaire-wade-expected-to-attend-sierra-canyon/ |access-date=June 2, 2019}}</ref> Sierra Canyon's basketball program, under head coach Andre Chevalier, was one of the best in the nation and won the previous two [[California Interscholastic Federation]] (CIF) Open Division state titles.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Gray |first1=Tim |last2=Martin |first2=Jill |title=With NBA bloodlines, the Sierra Canyon boys basketball team is in the national spotlight |url=https://www.cnn.com/2019/12/20/us/sierra-canyon-hs-boys-basketball-spt-intl/index.html |publisher=[[CNN]] |access-date=February 23, 2023 |date=December 20, 2019}}</ref> The 2019–20 team was led by five-star recruits, [[Brandon Boston Jr.]] and [[Ziaire Williams]], who transferred there for their senior years.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Smith |first=Cam |date=July 20, 2019 |title=With addition of Chosen 25 5-star Brandon Boston, is Sierra Canyon's 2019-20 roster the best ever? |url=https://usatodayhss.com/2019/brandon-boston-sierra-canyon-roster-best-ever |access-date=July 23, 2019 |website=USA Today High School Sports}}</ref> Entering the season, [[ESPN]] announced that its networks would air 15 of the team's games.<ref name="wells">{{Cite web |last=Wells |first=Adam |date=November 15, 2019 |title=Bronny James, Zaire Wade Sierra Canyon Team to Appear on ESPN Networks 15 Times |url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2862925-bronny-james-zaire-wade-sierra-canyon-team-to-appear-on-espn-networks-15-times |access-date=December 15, 2019 |publisher=[[Bleacher Report]]}}</ref> Despite heavy media attention, James's father barred him from being interviewed.<ref>{{cite news |last=Golliver |first=Ben |title=Like father, like son: Bronny James, LeBron's kid, is the biggest draw in high school hoops |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/2019/12/06/bronny-james-lebron-son-sierra-canyon-nba/ |newspaper=[[The Washington Post]] |access-date=February 23, 2023 |date=December 6, 2019}}</ref>

On November 21, 2019, James made his high school debut, scoring 10 points off the bench in a 91–44 win over [[Montgomery High School (San Diego)|Montgomery High School]].<ref name="divens">{{Cite web |last=Divens |first=Jordan |date=November 22, 2019 |title=Bronny James makes high school basketball debut, No. 3 Sierra Canyon dominates opener |url=https://www.maxpreps.com/news/fu31SHtnSUWR7qOTnaRWkw/bronny-james-makes-high-school-basketball-debut,-no-3-sierra-canyon-dominates-opener.htm |access-date=December 15, 2019 |publisher=[[MaxPreps]]}}</ref> On December 14, he scored 15 points, including a go-ahead layup, and was named the game's [[most valuable player]] (MVP) in a 59–56 victory over his father's alma mater, [[St. Vincent–St. Mary High School]].<ref name="baby">{{Cite web |last=Baby |first=Ben |date=December 14, 2019 |title=Bronny James scores go-ahead layup with dad LeBron courtside |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/28300403 |access-date=December 15, 2019 |publisher=[[ESPN]]}}</ref> On January 15, 2020, James scored a season-high 17 points in a 117–62 win over [[Viewpoint School]].<ref name="freshman">{{Cite web |last=Fattal |first=Tarek |date=February 14, 2020 |title=Bronny James: Highlights and top moments, freshman season at Sierra Canyon |url=https://www.dailynews.com/2020/02/14/bronny-james-highlights-and-top-moments-freshman-season-at-sierra-canyon/ |access-date=May 9, 2020 |website=[[Los Angeles Daily News]]}}</ref> Five days later, during a Hoophall Classic game against [[Paul VI Catholic High School]], an orange peel was thrown by a young fan at James, causing a brief stoppage of play. Although the offender was not immediately identified, a clip of the incident went [[viral video|viral]], drawing criticism from James’ father, and the fan issued an apology.<ref>{{cite web |last=Borzello |first=Jeff |title=LeBron James disappointed after 'disrespectful' move, as fan throws debris at Bronny James in defeat |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/28526071 |publisher=[[ESPN]] |access-date=February 23, 2023 |date=January 20, 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Westerholm |first=Tom |title=Child who threw orange peel at Bronny James at 2020 Hoophall Classic apologizes to LeBron James, family |url=https://www.masslive.com/celtics/2020/01/child-who-threw-orange-peel-at-bronny-james-at-2020-hoophall-classic-apologizes-to-lebron-james-family.html |website=[[The Republican (Springfield, Massachusetts)|The Republican]] |access-date=February 23, 2023 |date=January 21, 2020}}</ref> Sierra Canyon reached the Open Division state championship game, which was canceled due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Sondheimer |first=Eric |title=CIF state basketball games canceled because of coronavirus |url=https://www.latimes.com/sports/highschool/story/2020-03-12/la-sp-cif-state-basketball-tourney-no-fans |website=[[Los Angeles Times]] |access-date=February 23, 2023 |date=March 12, 2020}}</ref> As a freshman, James averaged 4.1 points in 15 minutes per game, as Sierra Canyon finished with a 30–4 record, and was his team's only player to appear in all 34 games of the season.<ref name="freshman"/>

===Sophomore season===
On November 12, 2020, James played his first preseason game as a sophomore for California Basketball Club (CBC), a travel team representing Sierra Canyon, against Air Nado, a team affiliated with [[Coronado High School (Nevada)|Coronado High School]], at the [[High School Showcase]]. He scored nine points, all in the first half.<ref>{{cite web |last=Fattal |first=Tarek |title=Sierra Canyon, Bronny James playing as 'CBC' on ESPN2 Thursday night |url=https://www.dailynews.com/2020/11/12/sierra-canyon-bronny-james-playing-as-cbc-on-espn2-thursday-night/ |website=[[Los Angeles Daily News]] |access-date=February 23, 2023 |date=November 12, 2020}}</ref> In February 2021, James [[Meniscus tear|tore his meniscus]] at practice and underwent surgery. Due to the COVID-19 pandemic, he had not played any official games for Sierra Canyon in the 2020–21 season, which was set to begin later that year.<ref>{{cite web |title=Sources: Bronny James undergoes knee surgery after tearing meniscus |url=https://www.espn.com/espn/story/_/id/30965114 |publisher=[[ESPN]] |access-date=February 24, 2023 |date=February 25, 2021}}</ref> After missing most of the season, James returned against [[Centennial High School (Corona, California)|Centennial High School]] in the [[CIF Southern Section]] Open Division final on June 11. He scored seven points in an 80–72 loss.<ref>{{cite web |last=Williams |first=Brianna |title=LeBron James, Drake and more in attendance for Bronny James' star-studded season debut |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/31615229 |publisher=[[ESPN]] |access-date=February 24, 2023 |date=June 11, 2021}}</ref> Sierra Canyon, led by junior [[Amari Bailey]], finished the season with a 16–2 record.<ref>{{cite web |last=Fattal |first=Tarek |title=Sierra Canyon's Amari Bailey headlines 2021 All-Area boys basketball team |url=https://www.dailynews.com/2021/06/25/sierra-canyons-amari-bailey-headlines-2021-all-area-boys-basketball-team/ |website=[[Los Angeles Daily News]] |access-date=February 24, 2023 |date=June 25, 2021}}</ref>

===Junior season===
In James' junior season, his Sierra Canyon team was led by seniors Amari Bailey and Kijani Wright.<ref>{{cite web |last=Williams |first=Brianna |title=Bronny James and Sierra Canyon boys' basketball to take on LeBron James' alma mater at Staples Center |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/32781331 |publisher=[[ESPN]] |access-date=February 24, 2023 |date=December 3, 2021}}</ref> On December 4, 2021, he scored a game-high 19 points in a 71–53 win over St. Vincent–St. Mary High School in the Chosen-1's Invitational at [[Staples Center]], as Bailey was sidelined with an ankle injury.<ref>{{cite web |last=Fattal |first=Tarek |title=Sierra Canyon's Bronny James shines against St. Vincent-St. Mary, again |url=https://www.dailynews.com/2021/12/05/sierra-canyons-bronny-james-shines-against-st-vincent-st-mary-again/ |website=[[Los Angeles Daily News]] |access-date=February 24, 2023 |date=December 5, 2021}}</ref> His team was upset by [[Harvard-Westlake School]] in the CIF Southern Section Open Division semifinals, where he scored four points.<ref>{{cite web |last=O'Donnell |first=Ricky |title=Bronny James has a roadmap to the NBA despite playing nothing like his dad |url=https://www.sbnation.com/nba/2022/3/9/22956487/bronny-james-nba-draft-scouting-report |publisher=[[SB Nation]] |access-date=February 24, 2023 |date=March 9, 2022}}</ref>

Sierra Canyon reached the Open Division regional final, losing to Centennial High School, 83–59, and James was held scoreless while playing through hip soreness. The team ended the season with a 26–5 record.<ref>{{cite web |last=Fattal |first=Tarek |title=Sierra Canyon boys basketball falls to Centennial in SoCal Open Division regional final |url=https://www.dailynews.com/2022/03/08/sierra-canyon-boys-basketball-falls-to-corona-centennial-in-open-division-socal-regional-final/ |website=[[Los Angeles Daily News]] |access-date=February 24, 2023 |date=March 8, 2022}}</ref> As a junior, James averaged 8.8 points, 3.3 rebounds, 2.8 assists and 1.9 steals per game in 29 appearances.<ref name="junior">{{cite web |last=Fattal |first=Tarek |title=Bronny James, Sierra Canyon boys basketball will see top players transfer out this summer |url=https://www.dailynews.com/2022/06/03/bronny-james-sierra-canyon-boys-basketball-sees-top-players-transfer-out/ |website=[[Los Angeles Daily News]] |access-date=February 24, 2023 |date=June 3, 2022}}</ref>

===Senior season===
In his senior season, James stepped into a leading role and was joined on the team by his younger brother, [[Bryce Maximus James|Bryce]].<ref name="leader">{{cite web |last=Fattal |first=Tarek |title=Sierra Canyon basketball's Bronny James leads by example in a contagious way |url=https://www.dailynews.com/2022/12/09/sierra-canyons-bronny-james-leads-by-example-in-a-contagious-way/ |website=[[Los Angeles Daily News]] |access-date=February 25, 2023 |date=December 9, 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last=Swanson |first=Mike |title=Two princes: Bronny James, Bryce James take the court together in London |newspaper=Sports Illustrated High School News, Analysis and More |url=https://news.scorebooklive.com/national/2022/08/11/two-princes-bronny-james-bryce-james-take-the-court-together-in-london |publisher=Scorebook Live |access-date=February 24, 2023 |date=August 11, 2022}}</ref> In August 2022, he played alongside his Sierra Canyon teammates for CBC in three [[exhibition game]]s in Europe. In his second game, James led all scorers with 25 points in a 97–85 loss to U18 French Select in [[Paris]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Biancardi |first=Paul |title=Bronny James, Bryce James and CBC play three-game Europe trip: Analysis, highlights and more |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/insider/story/_/id/34374040 |publisher=[[ESPN]] |access-date=February 24, 2023 |date=August 18, 2022}}</ref> On October 29, James and his team were evacuated from a preseason game against the Hyattsville Stags, a team representing [[DeMatha Catholic High School]], after a fight broke out in the stands and a fan reported seeing a gun. Although no firearms were found, the game was not resumed.<ref>{{cite news |last=Shugan |first=Zach |title=Shooting scare clears gym at basketball game featuring Bronny James and Sierra Canyon, DeMatha Catholic |newspaper=Sports Illustrated High School News, Analysis and More |url=https://news.scorebooklive.com/national/2022/10/30/shooting-scare-clears-gymnasium-at-high-school-basketball-game-featuring-bronny-james-and-sierra-canyon-teammates |publisher=Scorebook Live |access-date=February 24, 2023 |date=October 29, 2022}}</ref>

After missing the first two regular season games with an illness, James made his senior debut on November 26, recording 13 points, four assists and three rebounds in a 63–60 overtime loss to Rancho Christian School.<ref>{{cite web |last=Mujid |first=Zaakirah |title=Bronny James flashes high-level potential in senior debut |url=https://bvmsports.com/2022/11/28/bronny-james-flashes-high-level-potential-in-senior-debut/ |publisher=BVM Sports |access-date=February 25, 2023 |date=November 29, 2022}}</ref> In his first home game on November 30, he scored 25 points in a 77–61 win over [[Crossroads School (Santa Monica, California)|Crossroads School]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Evans |first=Luca |title=Bronny James leads Sierra Canyon over Crossroads in home debut |url=https://www.latimes.com/sports/highschool/story/2022-11-30/sierra-canyon-bronny-james-crossroads-recap |website=[[Los Angeles Times]] |access-date=February 25, 2023 |date=November 30, 2022}}</ref> In January 2023, James missed four games with a knee injury and scored 19 points in his return on February 1 as his team lost to [[Notre Dame High School (Sherman Oaks, California)|Notre Dame High School]], 88–61, at the [[Mission League]] semifinals.<ref>{{cite web |last=Fattal |first=Tarek |title=Notre Dame advances to Mission League basketball final; Sierra Canyon loses again |url=https://www.dailynews.com/2023/02/01/notre-dame-advances-to-mission-league-final-sierra-canyons-open-division-berth-looms/ |website=[[Los Angeles Daily News]] |access-date=February 25, 2023 |date=February 1, 2023}}</ref> Sierra Canyon was relegated from the CIF Open Division to Division I after its worst performance in the regular season and Southern Section Open Division playoffs in the tenure of Andre Chevalier.<ref>{{cite web |last=Evans |first=Luca |title=Bronny James and Sierra Canyon advance to regional finals |url=https://www.latimes.com/sports/highschool/story/2023-03-04/sierra-canyon-bishop-montgomery-bronny-james-recap |website=[[Los Angeles Times]] |access-date=March 7, 2023 |date=March 4, 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Fattal |first=Tarek |title=Sierra Canyon's Bronny James win away from state finals trip after being blocked in 2020 |url=https://www.dailynews.com/2023/03/05/sierra-canyons-bronny-james-is-one-win-away-from-cif-state-final-he-couldnt-play-in-2020/ |website=[[Los Angeles Daily News]] |access-date=March 7, 2023 |date=March 5, 2023}}</ref> James scored 10 points in an 80–68 season-ending loss to Notre Dame High School at the Division I regional final.<ref>{{cite web |last=Evans |first=Luca |title=Sherman Oaks Notre Dame routs Sierra Canyon, Bronny James |url=https://www.latimes.com/sports/highschool/story/2023-03-07/sierra-canyon-vs-notre-dame-basketball-recap |website=[[Los Angeles Times]] |access-date=March 9, 2023 |date=March 7, 2023}}</ref> As a senior, he averaged 14.2 points, 5.5 rebounds, 2.4 assists and 1.8 steals per game, leading his team to a 23–11 record.<ref>{{cite web |last=Divens |first=Jordan |title=Duke signee Caleb Foster leads Notre Dame past Sierra Canyon 80-61 in California state semifinals, ends high school career of Bronny James |url=https://www.maxpreps.com/news/kDvXdBa28kOoir3Y_53B3A/duke-signee-caleb-foster-leads-notre-dame-past-sierra-canyon-80-61-in-california-state-semifinals%2c-ends-high-school-career-of-bronny-james.htm |publisher=[[MaxPreps]] |access-date=March 9, 2023 |date=March 7, 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last=Stephens |first=Mitch |title=Bronny James prep career ends; Notre Dame beats Sierra Canyon for fourth time to win SoCal D1 title |newspaper=Sports Illustrated High School News, Analysis and More |url=https://news.scorebooklive.com/national/2023/03/08/bronny-james-sierra-canyon |publisher=Scorebook Live |access-date=March 9, 2023 |date=March 8, 2023}}</ref> He was selected to play in the [[2023 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|McDonald's All-American Game]] and was named to the United States team for the [[Nike Hoop Summit]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Peter |first=Josh |title=Should Bronny James have made McDonald's All American game? Scouts weigh in. |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/preps/basketball/2023/01/27/bronny-james-lebron-son-mcdonalds-all-american-game-scouts/11129661002/ |website=[[USA Today]] |access-date=February 25, 2023 |date=January 27, 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Gardner |first=Steve |title=Bronny James named to USA roster for Nike Hoop Summit |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/highschool/2023/02/15/bronny-james-named-usa-basketball-roster-nike-hoop-summit/11262193002/ |website=[[USA Today]] |access-date=February 25, 2023 |date=February 15, 2023}}</ref> James scored 15 points, making five three-pointers which tied the record for most made three-pointers in the event ever while dishing out 4 assists and 2 steals , in a 109–106 loss at the McDonald's All-American Game and finished second in the event's dunk contest.<ref>{{cite web |title=LeBron James reacts as Bronny finishes second in dunk contest |url=https://www.foxsports.com/stories/nba/lebron-reacts-as-bronny-james-finishes-second-in-dunk-contest |work=[[Fox Sports]] |access-date=May 9, 2023 |date=March 28, 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Evans |first=Jace |title=How did Bronny James fare in McDonald's All American Game? |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/basketball/2023/03/28/bronny-james-mcdonalds-all-american-game/11559808002/ |website=[[USA Today]] |access-date=May 9, 2023 |date=March 28, 2023}}</ref> In the Nike Hoop Summit, he scored 11 points, 4 rebounds, a steal and a block as along with hitting the go ahead free-throws as his team won, 90–84.<ref>{{cite web |last=Pelton |first=Kevin |title=With LeBron front row, Bronny James leads U.S. at Nike Hoop Summit |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/36127955 |publisher=[[ESPN]] |access-date=May 9, 2023 |date=April 9, 2023}}</ref>

==College career==
On July 24, 2023, at approximately 9:26 a.m. PDT, James collapsed at the [[Galen Center]] during a USC practice session. It was later revealed that he had suffered [[cardiac arrest]] caused by a congenital heart defect.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Polacek |first=Scott |title=Bronny James' Collapse Caused by Heart Defect; Confidence He'll Return to Basketball |url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/10087297-bronny-james-collapse-caused-by-heart-defect-confidence-hell-return-to-basketball |access-date=2023-08-26 |website=Bleacher Report |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2023/07/25/sports/ncaabasketball/bronny-james-cardiac-arrest-lebron.html |title=Bronny James, Son of LeBron James, Is Stable After Cardiac Arrest |date=July 25, 2023 |last1=Ganguli |first1=Tania |last2=Witz |first2=Billy |last3=Kolata |first3=Gina |work=[[The New York Times]] |access-date=July 25, 2023}}</ref> James was released from the hospital on July 27.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Archie |first1=Ayana |title=LeBron James' son is released from hospital days after suffering a cardiac arrest |url=https://www.npr.org/2023/07/27/1190609984/lebron-james-son-bronny-james-cardiac-arrest-released-from-hospital |work=National Public Radio |date=July 27, 2023}}</ref> James was projected as a top ten pick in the [[2024 NBA draft]] and according to Jonathan Givony, was seen as the most improved prospect in the country before his cardiac arrest.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Kasabian |first=Paul |title=Kevin Durant on Bronny James Being Projected Top-10 Pick: 'I Can Understand Why' |url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/10068985-kevin-durant-on-bronny-james-being-projected-top-10-pick-i-can-understand-why |access-date=2024-03-26 |website=Bleacher Report |language=en}}</ref>

Less than five months removed from his cardiac arrest, James made his collegiate debut for the Trojans on December 10, finishing with four points, three rebounds, two assists, two steals, and one block off the bench.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Youngmisuk |first1=Ohm |title='Thankful' Bronny James comes off bench in USC debut |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/39083268/usc-bronny-james-come-bench-debut |website=ESPN.com |date=December 10, 2023 |access-date=11 December 2023}}</ref> On December 30, James scored a career-high 15 points on 6-of-11 from the field and had three assists in a road loss against [[Oregon State Beavers men's basketball|Oregon State]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Gardner |first1=Steve |title=Bronny James scores career-high 15 points, including highlight-reel dunk, in USC loss |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/ncaab/pac12/2023/12/31/bronny-james-comeback-15-points-usc-highlight-reel-dunk/72072567007/ |website=usatoday.com |access-date=March 1, 2024}}</ref> On January 17, 2024, James played a season-high 30 minutes and recorded 11 points, five rebounds and six assists in an 82–67 loss to No. 12 [[Arizona Wildcats men's basketball|Arizona]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Geitheim |first1=Eva |title=USC Basketball: Andy Enfield Shouts Out Bronny James For Stepping Up In Arizona Loss |url=https://www.si.com/college/usc/basketball/usc-basketball-andy-enfield-shouts-out-bronny-james-for-stepping-up-in-arizona-loss-eg2001 |website=si.com |access-date=March 1, 2024}}</ref> James appeared in USC’s final 25 games, starting six and averaging 4.8 points, 2.8 rebounds and 2.1 assists in 19.3 minutes.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Charania |first1=Shams |last2=Andrejev |first2=Alex |title=Bronny James declares for 2024 NBA Draft, enters transfer portal |url=https://theathletic.com/5392978/2024/04/05/bronny-james-nba-draft-transfer-portal-declaration/?redirected=1&source=googlesearch&access_token=12484026 |website=The Athletic |access-date=April 5, 2024}}</ref>

On April 5, 2024, James announced on [[Instagram]] that he would enter the 2024 NBA draft while maintaining his college eligibility and also enter the [[NCAA transfer portal|transfer portal]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Wojnarowski |first1=Adrian |title=USC's Bronny James entering NBA draft, transfer portal |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/39879943/usc-bronny-james-entering-nba-draft-transfer-portal |website=ESPN.com |access-date=April 5, 2024}}</ref>

In early May of 2024, James was medically cleared to be eligible for the NBA draft.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Wojnarowski |first1=Adrian |last2=Givony |first2=Jonathan|title=Bronny James medically cleared to play in NBA |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/40137289/bronny-james-medically-cleared-play-nba-sources-say |website=ESPN.com |date=May 13, 2024|access-date=May 13, 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Charania |first1=Shams |last2=Weese |first2=Lukas|last3=Vecenie |first3=Sam |title=Bronny James expected to stay in 2024 NBA Draft|url=https://theathletic.com/5489626/2024/05/13/bronny-james-nba-draft-combine/ |website=[[The Athletic]] |date=May 13, 2024|access-date=May 13, 2024}}</ref> On May 28, 2024, it was reported that James had at least 10 workout invites from NBA teams but will only visit a "couple" of those teams, which include the [[Los Angeles Lakers|Lakers]] and the [[Phoenix Suns|Suns]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=May 28, 2024 |title=Bronny James NBA Draft projection: LeBron's son plans to visit Lakers and Suns, per report |url=https://www.cbssports.com/nba/news/bronny-james-nba-draft-projection-lebrons-son-plans-to-visit-lakers-and-suns-per-report/ |access-date=May 28, 2024 |website=CBSSports.com |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Boone |first1=Kyle |date=May 28, 2024 |title=Bronny James elects to remain in draft as USC freshman will forfeit his college eligibility |url=https://www.cbssports.com/nba/news/2024-nba-draft-bronny-james-elects-to-remain-in-draft-as-usc-freshman-will-forfeit-his-college-eligibility/ |access-date=May 29, 2024 |website=CBSSports.com |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Morik |first1=Ryan |date=May 28, 2024 |title=Bronny James eyes two NBA teams after declining nearly 10 pre-draft workouts |url=https://www.foxnews.com/sports/bronny-james-eyes-two-nba-teams-after-declining-nearly-10-pre-draft-workouts-report |access-date=May 29, 2024 |website=FoxNews.com |language=en}}</ref>

==Player profile==
James stands at {{convert|6|ft|1.5|in}}<ref>{{cite news | last=Zucker | first=Joseph | title=Bronny James NBA Combine 2024: Measurements, Analysis and Impressions | date=May 13, 2024 | url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/10120887-bronny-james-nba-combine-2024-measurements-analysis-and-impressions | work=Bleacher Report }}</ref> and can play the [[point guard]] and [[shooting guard]] positions. Analysts have described shooting and defense as his main strengths, although he lacks the size of most NBA players with his skill set.<ref name="moore">{{cite web |last=Moore |first=CJ |title=Bronny James is good, but can LeBron's son meet expectations? |url=https://theathletic.com/4489642/2023/05/06/bronny-james-scout-lebron-usc/ |website=[[The Athletic]] |access-date=May 9, 2023 |date=May 6, 2023}}</ref><ref name="athletic">{{cite web |last1=Bass |first1=Tobias |last2=Hamilton |first2=Brian |last3=Vecenie |first3=Sam |title=Bronny James commits to USC: How the 4-star combo guard fits with the Trojans |url=https://theathletic.com/4494950/2023/05/06/usc-bronny-james-commitment/ |website=[[The Athletic]] |access-date=May 9, 2023 |date=May 6, 2023}}</ref> James excels in catch-and-shoot situations and is also capable of shooting off movement.<ref name=moore/> He can defend point guards and his defensive anticipation and intensity have been praised.<ref name="irving">{{cite web |last=Irving |first=Kyle |title=How good is Bronny James? Senior year high school scouting report proves LeBron's son is better than you think |url=https://www.sportingnews.com/us/nba/news/bronny-james-how-good-scouting-report-lebron/zewbobjhvpatvohcsek48eh5 |website=[[The Sporting News]] |access-date=May 9, 2023 |date=March 29, 2023}}</ref> In 2023, ESPN NBA draft analyst Jonathan Givony noted that James was developing into one of the top perimeter defenders in his class.<ref name="givony">{{cite web |last=Givony |first=Jonathan |title=2024 NBA mock draft: Why Bronny James is projected as a top-10 pick |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/insider/insider/story/_/id/35707557 |publisher=[[ESPN]] |access-date=May 9, 2023 |date=February 22, 2023}}</ref> James has a high basketball IQ and is a willing passer.<ref name=wasserman>{{cite web |last=Wasserman |first=Jonathan |title=Full NBA Scouting Report for Sierra Canyon's Bronny James |url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2953737-full-nba-scouting-report-for-sierra-canyons-bronny-james |publisher=[[Bleacher Report]] |access-date=May 9, 2023 |date=February 23, 2022}}</ref> Although he is a reliable ball-handler, he can struggle to create separation from defenders. His driving and finishing abilities have been labeled as weaknesses, despite him having the strength to finish through contact.<ref name=moore/><ref name="odonnell">{{cite web |last=O'Donnell |first=Ricky |title=Bronny James has a roadmap to the NBA despite playing nothing like his dad |url=https://www.sbnation.com/nba/2022/3/9/22956487/bronny-james-nba-draft-scouting-report |publisher=SB Nation |access-date=May 9, 2023 |date=March 9, 2022}}</ref> James's playing style has drawn comparisons to [[De'Anthony Melton]], [[Lonzo Ball]], and [[Jrue Holiday]].<ref name=wasserman/>

==Personal life==
James’ godfather is NBA All-Star [[Chris Paul]],<ref>{{Cite web |last=Cwik |first=Chris |date=March 5, 2018 |title=LeBron James Jr. put on a dominant show with godfather Chris Paul watching |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/lebron-james-jr-put-dominant-show-godfather-chris-paul-watching-054004587.html |access-date=July 31, 2018 |publisher=[[Yahoo Sports]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Chris Paul Stats |url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/players/p/paulch01.html |access-date=June 2, 2019 |publisher=[[Sports Reference|Basketball Reference]]}}</ref> who is a close friend of his father.<ref>{{cite web |last=Helin |first=Kurt |title=LeBron helping Chris Paul count down wins left until NBA title |url=https://nba.nbcsports.com/2021/07/09/lebron-helping-chris-paul-count-down-wins-left-until-nba-title/ |publisher=[[NBC Sports]] |access-date=May 9, 2023 |date=July 9, 2021}}</ref>

In 2020, James signed with [[esports]] organization [[FaZe Clan]]. Through the partnership, he was expected to stream ''[[Fortnite]]'' and ''[[Call of Duty: Warzone]]'' under the handle "FaZe Bronny."<ref>{{cite magazine |title=Bronny James, LeBron's Son, Joins Professional Esports Organization |url=https://www.si.com/more-sports/2020/08/31/bronny-james-joins-pro-esports-organization |magazine=[[Sports Illustrated]] |publisher=[[Associated Press]] |access-date=May 9, 2023 |date=August 30, 2020}}</ref> In June 2021, James made his first appearance on the cover of ''[[Sports Illustrated]]'' alongside members of FaZe Clan, including [[NFL]] quarterback [[Kyler Murray]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Singh |first=Sanjesh |title=Bronny James makes first cover of Sports Illustrated with FaZe Clan |url=https://lebronwire.usatoday.com/2021/06/10/bronny-james-makes-first-cover-of-sports-illustrated-with-faze-clan/ |publisher=LeBron Wire |access-date=May 9, 2023 |date=June 10, 2021}}</ref>

James has established a large [[social media]] following since high school.<ref>{{cite web |last=Smith |first=KJ |title=World's most influential teenage basketball players |url=https://www.on3.com/news/worlds-most-influential-teenage-basketball-players/ |publisher=On3 |access-date=May 9, 2023 |date=August 18, 2021}}</ref> In May 2019, he started an [[Instagram]] account and reached one million followers in his first day on the platform.<ref>{{cite web |last=Baer |first=Jack |title=Bronny James rants about girls and weed, gets smack-talked by Draymond Green in first day on Instagram |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/lebron-james-bronny-instagram-followers-draymond-green-041030248.html |publisher=[[Yahoo! Sports]] |access-date=May 9, 2023 |date=May 29, 2019}}</ref> By the end of high school, James had over seven million followers on Instagram.<ref>{{cite news|last=Zagoria |first=Adam |title=Bronny James Commits to U.S.C. as Father Dreams of N.B.A. Meet-Up |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2023/05/07/sports/basketball/bronny-lebron-james-usc.html |work=[[The New York Times]] |access-date=May 9, 2023 |date=May 7, 2023}}</ref>

Analysts have projected James as having one of the highest-earning potentials from his [[Student athlete compensation|name, image and likeness]] (NIL) among college athletes.<ref>{{cite web |last=Pope |first=Keegan |title=Bronny James tops NIL valuation projections from On3 |url=https://www.on3.com/nil/news/bronny-james-tops-nil-valuation-projections-from-on3/ |publisher=On3 |access-date=May 9, 2023 |date=May 6, 2023}}</ref> In February 2022, he filed for trademarks on variations of his name: Bronny, BJ Jr. and Bronald.<ref>{{cite magazine |last=Pickman |first=Ben |title=LeBron James Jr. Files Three Trademarks for Variety of Names |url=https://www.si.com/extra-mustard/2022/02/02/bronny-james-files-trademark-names |magazine=[[Sports Illustrated]] |access-date=May 9, 2023 |date=February 2, 2022}}</ref> In high school, James signed NIL deals with [[Nike, Inc.|Nike]] and [[Beats Electronics|Beats by Dre]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Greer |first=Jordan |title=Bronny James' NIL deals, explained: Nike, Beats by Dre among brands teaming up with LeBron's son |url=https://www.sportingnews.com/us/nba/news/bronny-james-nil-deals-nike-beats-by-dre-lebron-son/wnbonsmou3k1gmkrk5eixtoq |website=[[The Sporting News]] |access-date=May 9, 2023 |date=March 28, 2023}}</ref>

James has worn the number 0 jersey because it is the number worn by his favorite NBA player, [[Russell Westbrook]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Bohlin |first=Michael |date=February 17, 2018 |title=Russell Westbrook plays one-on-one with LeBron James Jr. |url=https://247sports.com/nba/cleveland-cavaliers/article/russell-westbrook-plays-one-on-one-with-lebron-james-jr-115246380/ |access-date=August 1, 2018 |publisher=[[247Sports]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Dator |first=James |date=March 15, 2016 |title=LeBron loves that his kids chose to wear Steph Curry and Russell Westbrook's numbers instead of his |url=https://www.sbnation.com/lookit/2016/3/15/11233056/lebron-james-sons-russell-westbrook-steph-curry-numbers-nba |access-date=July 31, 2018 |publisher=[[SB Nation]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Newport |first=Kyle |date=March 15, 2016 |title=LeBron James Says Sons Chose Numbers in Honor of Steph Curry, Russell Westbrook |url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2624875-lebron-james-says-sons-chose-numbers-in-honor-of-steph-curry-russell-westbrook |access-date=July 31, 2018 |publisher=[[Bleacher Report]]}}</ref> He has also worn the number 23 jersey in honor of his father.<ref name=number23/>
